name: Enforcer
original_name: 執行人《エンフォーサー》
source:
The ultimate weapon for the secret society known as C.R.O.W.N. that's chasing after the main characters.

As a result of being shot in the head, he lost his sense of pain. Due to this, he isn't afraid of getting injured and is unrivaled in hand-to-hand combat.

Because of a previous near-death experience, he commits murders with "love" to save his victims.

Hometown: France
